summary: Overcrowded jail conditions; torture prevention; prison decongestion; free legal aid access for inmates; constitutional right under Article 21; mandatory magistrate obligation to inform accused of legal aid rights; procedural fairness as essential liberty safeguard; State duty to provide legal services regardless of prisoner initiative; illiteracy and poverty as barriers to legal access; judicial monitoring of legal aid implementation.
legal_provisions_cited: Hussainara Khatoon and Others (IV) v. Home Secretary, State of Bihar
Khatri and Others (2) v. State of Bihar and Others
Suk Das v. Union Territory of Arunachal Pradesh
Madhav Hayawadanrao Hoskot v. State of Maharashtra
final_judgment: Prayer allowed; prison decongestion direction; legal aid access mechanism established; State duty enforced.
